main_measure.name: mean of forecast/10 x drift-removed 2-bar return on Thursday-close bars

statistic.name: t of the mean, cases of one day summed

main_measure.threshold: t >= 2 confirms (with the check passing), t <= -2 rejects, otherwise inconclusive

supporting_check.name: top third minus bottom third of forecasts, mean drift-removed 2-bar return, above 0

decided_by: The main measure's t is >= 2 and the top-minus-bottom-third check is above 0 (confirm rule).
reading: Thursday-close bars are bars starting Thursday UTC with a nonzero forecast and a full 2-bar return inside the window (weekly spacing makes them non-overlapping), the drift is each coin's mean 2-bar return on the non-overlapping grid 0,2,4,... of all its windows, and the thirds are the floor(n/3) lowest and highest pooled forecasts.
